title: Zhuangzi 1, Xiaoyaoyou: the hinge is 待 — to lean on a condition
desc: Xiaoyaoyou is not about roaming far. The character 待 means to lean on a condition, and the whole chapter turns on whether you are still leaning.

title: Zhuangzi 2, Qiwulun: 齐 does not mean everything is the same
desc: Qiwulun is usually summarized as 'all things are equal'. 齐 originally is grain brought to one height. Two kinds of leveling: 合 merges difference, 和 holds it.

title: Zhuangzi 3, Yangshengzhu: 督 means the middle, and the blade goes through a gap
desc: The famous knife is not a lesson in skill. 督 glosses as 中, not the spine; the gap was already there, and 薪尽火传 is about what is passed, not what burns.

title: Zhuangzi 4, Renjianshi: 不得已 is about timing, not resignation
desc: The chapter people skip as office politics. 不得已 is not 'no choice' but 'the thing has arrived, then the response arises'. To impose benevolence is called 菑 — disaster.

title: Zhuangzi 5, Dechongfu: 符 is a tally that matches, not a badge you earn
desc: Three amputees open the chapter. 符 is a credential split in two that verifies when halves meet; 益生 comes straight from Daodejing 55, where adding to life is ill-omened.

title: Zhuangzi 6, Dazongshi: 真人 has no additions, not extra powers
desc: 真 is the unartificial: 真人 is the person with nothing added. 撄宁 is the calm that grows after disturbance — a stillness never struck is not 宁.

title: Zhuangzi 7, Yingdiwang: 应 means it answers, not that it ought to
desc: Read 应 as 'ought' and the chapter becomes a ruler's manual, the exact thing it dismantles. It ends with 浑沌, killed by two helpers boring apertures.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 1 (Pianmu): 骈 is two horses in one harness
desc: 骈 originally is two horses yoked abreast. The critique moves off true-or-false onto from-where: 侈 means excess, and 殉 means to be spent on something.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 2 (Mati): the horse did not turn bad, it learned
desc: Four cuts, then the stable: 烧, 剔, 刻, 烙. The horse learns to spit the bit. Pressure is not digested, it is learned — and 天放 is defined as 一而不党.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 3 (Quqie): 胠 means prying from the side
desc: 胠 is the flank: find the seam and enter from the side. 田成子 stole the state with its sagely statutes; 符玺 is trust made into an object, so it can be taken.
